description: Designed multi-factor sweep for joint wrapped-heavy-tail and Born-like behavior. All central couplings are unscaled inputs and are divided by sqrt(N_pixel) by born_hamiltonian_search.py.

cases.conditions: B1 exact matching; single X channel tests meridional locking in B2.
cases.hypothesis: Reference matched Ising point with the corrected perturbative collective coupling.

cases.conditions: B1 matching; B2 independent X/Y central channels; test B3 reciprocity.
cases.hypothesis: A second central quadrature should weaken meridional locking without leaving the perturbative regime.

cases.conditions: B1 matching; B2 noncommuting XX/YY detector mixing; B3 outcome test.
cases.hypothesis: Weak detector anisotropy broadens the resonant graph while preserving the matched Ising backbone.

cases.conditions: B1 approximate matching; B2 detector transverse field breaks commuting structure.
cases.hypothesis: A weak hx=0.01 perturbation may improve mixing before it broadens the matching condition excessively.

cases.conditions: B1-B2 matched mixing plus onset of HT1 exchange-band overlap.
cases.hypothesis: Small Jpm may broaden accessible transitions without creating the strongly locked heavy band.

cases.conditions: B1-B2 matching plus the Zeus heavy-tail onset near Jpm=0.1.
cases.hypothesis: Tests the lowest Zeus Jpm window that was consistently Cauchy-preferred.

cases.conditions: B1-B2 matching inside the strongest finite-N Jpm Born-score window; test HT4 and B3.
cases.hypothesis: Jpm=0.3 gave strong larger-N radial scores and may retain an intermediate heavy shoulder under X/Y mixing.

cases.conditions: Exact Jpm=J heavy regime combined with B1 matching and B2 X/Y mixing.
cases.hypothesis: A stringent compatibility test for an r^-2 intermediate shoulder and any later Born crossover.

cases.conditions: B1-B2 with weak central longitudinal Jz channel; probes phase dephasing without flips.
cases.hypothesis: Small longitudinal coupling may smooth phase coherence while preserving perturbative central exchange.

cases.conditions: B1-B2 with weak Z0-Xi mixing channel; tests an independent symmetry-breaking direction.
cases.hypothesis: A perturbative Jzx term may reduce residual meridional coherence without adding a large flip scale.

cases.conditions: B1 broadened matching; B2 weak disorder smooths atoms; test B3.
cases.hypothesis: Uniform hz disorder of width 0.01 is smaller than the base field and may regularize finite-size resonances.

cases.conditions: B1-B2 plus HT exchange graph with weak bond disorder; tests stable-law versus coherent-block tails.
cases.hypothesis: Weak Jpm disorder should reduce repeated phase atoms while retaining the Jpm=0.3 overlap window.

cases.conditions: Detunes B1 while keeping Jpm and X/Y mixing fixed.
cases.hypothesis: Half matching should reduce the Born profile if exact energy cancellation is causal.

cases.conditions: Removes B1 central matching while retaining HT exchange and B2 perturbations.
cases.hypothesis: Separates exchange-driven heavy tails from matched central energy transfer.

cases.conditions: B1 matching retained; HT3/B2 graph extension weakened by end-only chain coupling.
cases.hypothesis: Tests whether high connectivity, rather than matching alone, drives the candidate law.

cases.conditions: HT1-HT5 exchange band edge with weak field disorder and an added central Y quadrature.
cases.hypothesis: Combines the strongest local r^-2 screen with explicit mixing to test whether Born geometry improves.

cases.conditions: HT exchange-band center with X/Y mixing and weak Jpm disorder.
cases.hypothesis: Tests whether symmetry breaking can unlock the azimuth while retaining a filled tangent pole.

cases.conditions: Maximal HT3 connectivity and B2 mixing; tests coherent collective modes.
cases.hypothesis: All-to-all coupling may either enhance self-averaging or create a low-rank collective obstruction.

cases.conditions: Adds perturbative Sz-conserving central exchange to matched X/Y mixing.
cases.hypothesis: Tests whether an additional energy-conserving channel improves reciprocity or reinforces sector locking.

cases.conditions: Exact degeneracy with fragmented geometry; tests HT2-HT3 necessity under weak anisotropy.
cases.hypothesis: Raw degeneracy should remain insufficient when resonant blocks do not form an extended mixing graph.
